chunks: Al-Sakūnī narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
Do not withhold lending leavened dough and bread, for withholding them causes poverty.

key_terms.قَرْضَ: a loan or lending of something for temporary use

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about refusing to lend bread or leavened dough?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that one should not refuse others when they seek to borrow basic food items such as leavened dough and bread. It emphasizes generosity and social ease in daily necessities, warning that stinginess in such matters leads to poverty.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3973 - Al-Sakooni reported from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), peace be upon him, who said:
"Do not withhold lending leavened dough and bread, for withholding them causes poverty."
